name: Ja'Quan Taylor
title: Software Engineer
text: I’ve been lucky enough to work alongside Andrew, and honestly, he just makes being on a team better. What really stands out about him isn't just how smart he is, but how genuinely excited he gets about learning and figuring out better ways to do things. As a lead engineer, he handles complex, cross stack work extremely well and has managed everything from heavy backend data pipelines to seamless user experiences. Whether he’s digging into the guts of a system or trying out a new tool to make our daily work easier, he is always looking for the best possible way forward rather than just settling for what’s easy. Lately, this has been especially true with AI, he has taken it upon himself to teach the team how to use these new tools to speed up our daily work, but always emphasizes doing so responsibly without cutting corners. He approaches every new challenge with real curiosity, wanting to understand how things work at the core instead of just slapping on a quick fix. But the best part about working with Andrew is how generous he is with that knowledge. He’s always the first to say, "Hey, look what I found," and bring the rest of us along for the ride. Whether he’s running a workshop, mentoring someone on code style, or just writing down clear notes, he constantly goes out of his way to help the people around him grow. Andrew doesn't just build great systems, he builds great teams simply by being the kind of person who shares freely and collaborates openly. Any team would be incredibly lucky to have him around.

name: Pengbo Ma
title: Software Engineer
text: Andrew is by far one of the most thorough and intelligent person I have worked with. His attention to detail, his ability to bring forth not just the issues thats raised but also additional pointers that could help the future of the task is so incredibly important that I think anyone working with him will have the same feeling. He is extremely accountable for the tasks he is assigned and he ensures always the best quality of work is being produced.

name: Richard Navarrete
title: Software Engineering Leader
text: Andrew is incredibly talented and brings his vast experience to bear in all the chaotic waters he joins. He's delivered complex systems with little to no guidance, leading multiple teams, and mentoring peer and junior engineers growing the future of software engineering. He always has a sound approach to developing great software that is easy to maintain and a delight to expand. He's like a master architect and builder of construction but in the software world, carefully planning the future but delivering on time. If you have the chance to work with him, I can't recommend him enough. He'll make your whole org better.

name: ZJ (Zijian) Liu
title: Member of Technical Staff
text: I learned a lot from Andrew when working with him in YouTube T&S. With deep knowledge on many technology topics such as security, privacy, infrastructure, database schema, etc, Andrew constantly shared what he knows with the team to help others grow. It was also a pleasure to work with Andrew when designing a complex system with high payload, he was able to provide multiple solutions with clear trade-off, and therefore converge to the directions with in-depth analysis.

name: Joe McCann
title: Director Information Technology Services
text: Andrew was such a pleasure to work with during my tenure at Taco Bell/Yum.  Not only does he possess and utilize advanced technical skills, he is also accountable and holds himself to a very high standard.  He is capable of working efficiently and without direct supervision, is self-motivated and passionate about doing it right the first time.  I would recommend Andrew for a position with any company.
